title: Ada and the Wardrobe
author: Beatrix Thackeray
blurb: Gideon Villalobos, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
